title: Push Down Field

solutions.title: buyoutCreditsCents lives on LeaseToOwnRental only
solutions.tradeoff: The two functions that used to read buyoutCreditsCents off any InstrumentRental with a one-line `?? 0` now have to narrow to LeaseToOwnRental first - a filter step neither old one-liner needed - to buy a type that can no longer represent a trial rental with a buyout balance.

reviewFocus: Is buyoutCreditsCents still declared on InstrumentRental anywhere, even as a comment or a leftover `| null` on a type nothing constructs that way any more?
Is LeaseToOwnRental.buyoutCreditsCents typed as number, or did it stay number | null out of caution after the field moved?
Does remainingBuyoutCents still contain a `?? 0` guarding against a null that LeaseToOwnRental can no longer produce?

Compare against drill-12-02: that drill merges two fields into a shared base because they are used the same way. Does this walkthrough show the opposite check - that TrialRental never reads or writes buyoutCreditsCents at all - with the same rigor, or does it just assert the field is unused?

Do rentalLine and totalBuyoutCreditsCents both narrow to LeaseToOwnRental the same way - a type predicate, an instanceof check - or does one use a different technique than the other for no stated reason?
